phases.name: Phase 1: Prep & Foundation
phases.description: Establish 4-day weekly habit, build calf resilience (eccentric loading), core stability for lower back, adapt tendons.

phases.name: Phase 2: Aerobic Base Building
phases.description: Expand mitochondrial density, overcome the 18-20k calf cramp barrier with hydration/electrolytes, Pedder road hill repeats, 10K time trial benchmark.

phases.name: Phase 3: Peak & Race Specificity
phases.description: Peak volume tolerance, Marathon Pace threshold endurance, Half Marathon simulation, Peak 32 km Long Run.

phases.name: Phase 4: Taper & Race Execution
phases.description: Glycogen restoration, cellular repair, short sharp MP strides, race logistics and execution at Tata Mumbai Marathon.
